title: Administrator
description: Are you ready for a new challenge? Are you currently working in an administrative role and looking for your next career step? The community mental health team have a new position available as a Administrator and we are looking for a highly motivated, driven and diligent individual to work within our service. This would be a great transitional role for someone who is looking to progress further in their career. The successful candidate will need to be flexible, organised, accurate and efficient across all aspects of an administrative role. The individual will need to be IT literate with the ability to use Microsoft office competently. You will need a positive attitude towards people experiencing mental health problems and have excellent customer care skills. Within this position, there is a requirement to carry out line management duties for staff within the admin structure who you will work closely with on a day -to -day basis. The CMHS works with service users who have a range of mental health difficulties. We are a multi-disciplinary team of Consultant Psychiatrists, Psychiatric Nurses, Occupational Therapists, Psychologists, Support Workers and other key professionals. All Livewell Southwest staff are expected to able and willing to work across a 7 day service. Job Share(s) Considered Your role will be to work closely with the administration team & to provide support to the wider service & clinical team manager. Your main duties will include admin support for the clinical team which include, psychology, nursing staff &support workers. You will be required to arrange & re-schedule appointments, maintain accurate & up to date patient files on SystmOne & monitor waiting lists/reports. There will also be a requirement to cover periods of absence for other admin staff if required. This will include covering MDT, Triage & maintaining rotas. As such, we require someone with experience of office administration/secretarial work, proficient in efficient, precise &accurate record keeping and someone with experience of leading or supervising a team. Working within Livewell Southwest means you will be part of a team who provide specialist services to those who need support to live independent healthy lives. Does this sound like you? If so, then please make contact with the manager listed within the advert. We would be more then happy to have an informal discussion with you &answer any questions you may have. Please note that this role may not be eligible for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route, please refer to the Direct Gov website for more information with regards to eligibility Please note that we may close the job advert early if a high number of applications are submitted. Therefore, we recommend you submit your application at the earliest opportunity J OB PURPOSE To deliver an effective and competent level of secretarial and administrative support and consistently deliver a client focused service which promotes good customer service and effective working relationships. To be responsible for providing daily secretarial and administrative support in the allocated service area ensuring business priorities are met for example: maintaining records, minute taking, data inputting and reception duties. Typing of confidential reports/letters; which may be supplied via hard copy and/or dictation, (which may contain distressing information) as requested to meet service needs. Working proactively to support team. Ability to work on own and proactively as part of a team To provide the day-to-day supervision and line management of junior staff where appropriate. The job description and person specification are an outline of the tasks, responsibilities and outcomes required of the role. The job holder will need to be flexible to carry out any other duties as may be reasonably required by their line manager. SCOPE AND RANGE This post is expected to liaise and build positive working relationships with a variety of stakeholders such as; clinical staff, general practices, service users and all other appropriate bodies. MAIN DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES Management of service To arrange meetings and events on behalf of the service, making bookings where necessary and ensuring all equipment and documentation is available, in conjunction with line manager where required. Respond to telephone, email and written queries on behalf of the service area including call handling where appropriate as agreed with line manager. To produce informal and formal minutes as an accurate record of meetings, transcribing and distributing as directed. Maintain accurate and timely electronic and hard copy information e.g. training logs using organisational systems as directed (ensuring ease of access/retrieval as appropriate) and in line with policies. Supporting operational staff to access management information; electronic and hard copy. Collect and collate data to enable managers to monitor budgets and performance in relation to business support function with support of line manager. Collect, collate and prepare information for service area users with support of line manager. To provide support to customer and visitor reception areas, acting as the first point of enquiry and sign posting individual to relevant information / service. Support the management team to ensure that internal and external communication systems are in place. Ensure that all complaints, compliments, concerns, comments and suggestions are appropriately recorded, and where possible resolved within level of role or escalated appropriately, supporting junior staff where necessary. Maximise the use of electronic systems to enable effective management of the service area such as Microsoft Office and patient record systems. Be compliant with the Data Protection and record management policies and procedures with particular reference to confidentiality and safeguarding issues. Be proactive and contribute ideas for improvement in the way the service is delivered. Able to work on own initiative, prioritising work within defined policies and procedures to set timescales. Ensure that all office support services e.g. post, filing, photocopying, are delivered in a timely manner. Promote the image of the department, checking that notices and leaflets are up to date & well presented. Demonstrate own activities to new or less experienced employees. Financial management To process and pass for payment all relevant invoices in a timely manner in accordance with business process, with support of line manager. To support the line manager with banking and remittance service (including petty cash). Monitor stock e.g. stationery and order supplies and equipment as required within the business area. Undertake surveys or audits as directed. COMMUNICATIONS AND RELATIONSHIPS One of the main aspects of this role is to liaise and build positive working relationships with a variety of stakeholders such as; clinical staff, general practices, service users and all other appropriate bodies. PHYSICAL DEMANDS OF THE JOB Frequent sitting & standing. Inputting at a keyboard for most of day, frequent light effort to lift, sort & file case notes. May have to occasionally move presentation equipment and office supplies or clinic consumables.

title: Learning Management System (LMS ) Administrator
company: Torbay and South Devon NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Torbay and South Devon NHS Foundation Trust
description: We are looking for an experienced Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator to join the Digital Education Team, providing both front-end and back-end LMS support. It is essential that applicants have proven experience as a Totara Administrator. You will be responsible for managing and maintaining all back-end aspects of the Learning Management System (HIVE), which supports Torbay and South Devon NHS Foundation Trust and over 400 external partner organisations. You will play a key role in ensuring the effective delivery, development, and administration of the Trust's digital learning environment. Working closely with departments, subject matter experts, Learning Technologists, and other stakeholders, you will create and maintain online training courses, utilise Moodle learning activities, and develop organisation-specific and role-specific dashboards. You will support the ongoing enhancement of the HIVE, ensuring courses, certifications, user accounts, and system content remain accurate, compliant, and fit for purpose. You will use a range of analytical and data management skills to collect, manipulate, validate, interpret, and report on learning data, providing both routine and ad-hoc information to support organisational and workforce development needs. You will be responsible for the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data held within the Learning Management System, including carrying out audits and data validation processes. The post holderwill support and manage the Trusts Learning Management System (HIVE), ensuring the smooth operation, maintenance, and development of online learning and training resources. They will work closely with internal departments, trainers, subject matter experts, and external partner organisations to provide system support, develop and maintain training courses, and ensure data quality and compliance. Key responsibilities include managing a large catalogue of online training courses, creating and developing new learning content, dashboards, assessments and evaluations, maintaining user accounts and certification records, producing statutory and ad-hoc reports, and ensuring accurate learner data and compliance with Information Governance standards. The role requires collaboration with education, workforce, digital transformation, and administration teams, as well as external system providers, to support system enhancements and testing. The post holder will also monitor HIVE licences, support mandatory training requirements, provide user training, and deliver guidance on course maintenance and reporting. Working with a high degree of autonomy, the successful candidate will be responsible for prioritising their workload, responding to changing business demands, and contributing to the continuous improvement of the Trusts digital learning environment.
